# PF4J API Reference

> Source-linked Java API documentation for PF4J 3.15.0.

## Overview

- [PF4J API Reference](/api/overview/overview.html): Source-linked Java API documentation for PF4J 3.15.0.

## API Reference

- [AbstractExtensionFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-abstractextensionfinder.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [AbstractPluginManager](/api/reference/org-pf4j-abstractpluginmanager.html): This class implements the boilerplate plugin code that any `PluginManager` implementation would have to support.
- [ResolveRecoveryStrategy](/api/reference/org-pf4j-abstractpluginmanager-resolverecoverystrategy.html): Strategy for handling the recovery of a plugin that could not be resolved (loaded) due to a dependency problem.
- [BasePluginLoader](/api/reference/org-pf4j-basepluginloader.html): Load all information needed by a plugin.
- [BasePluginRepository](/api/reference/org-pf4j-basepluginrepository.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [ClassLoadingStrategy](/api/reference/org-pf4j-classloadingstrategy.html): `ClassLoadingStrategy` will be used to configure `PluginClassLoader` loading order and contains all possible options supported by `PluginClassLoader` where: A = Application Source (load classes from parent classLoader) P = Plugin Source (load classes from this classloader) D = Dependencies (load classes from dependencies) @endiliteral
- [Source](/api/reference/org-pf4j-classloadingstrategy-source.html): Defined in `pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/ClassLoadingStrategy.java:72`
- [CompoundPluginDescriptorFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-compoundplugindescriptorfinder.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [CompoundPluginLoader](/api/reference/org-pf4j-compoundpluginloader.html): A `PluginLoader` that delegates to a list of `PluginLoader`s.
- [CompoundPluginRepository](/api/reference/org-pf4j-compoundpluginrepository.html): A `PluginRepository` that delegates to a list of `PluginRepository`s.
- [DefaultExtensionFactory](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultextensionfactory.html): The default implementation for `ExtensionFactory`.
- [DefaultExtensionFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultextensionfinder.html): The default implementation for `ExtensionFinder`.
- [DefaultPluginClasspath](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultpluginclasspath.html): The default values are `CLASSES_DIR` and #LIB_DIR.
- [DefaultPluginDescriptor](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultplugindescriptor.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [DefaultPluginFactory](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultpluginfactory.html): The default implementation for `PluginFactory`.
- [DefaultPluginLoader](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultpluginloader.html): Load all information needed by a plugin from `DefaultPluginClasspath`.
- [DefaultPluginManager](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultpluginmanager.html): Default implementation of the `PluginManager` interface.
- [DefaultPluginRepository](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultpluginrepository.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [DefaultPluginStatusProvider](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultpluginstatusprovider.html): The default implementation for `PluginStatusProvider`.
- [DefaultVersionManager](/api/reference/org-pf4j-defaultversionmanager.html): Default implementation for `VersionManager`.
- [DependencyResolver](/api/reference/org-pf4j-dependencyresolver.html): This class builds a dependency graph for a list of plugins (descriptors).
- [CyclicDependencyException](/api/reference/org-pf4j-dependencyresolver-cyclicdependencyexception.html): It will be thrown if a cyclic dependency is detected.
- [DependenciesNotFoundException](/api/reference/org-pf4j-dependencyresolver-dependenciesnotfoundexception.html): Indicates that the dependencies required were not found.
- [DependenciesWrongVersionException](/api/reference/org-pf4j-dependencyresolver-dependencieswrongversionexception.html): Indicates that some dependencies have wrong version.
- [Result](/api/reference/org-pf4j-dependencyresolver-result.html): The result of the `resolve(List)` operation.
- [WrongDependencyVersion](/api/reference/org-pf4j-dependencyresolver-wrongdependencyversion.html): Represents a wrong dependency version.
- [DevelopmentPluginClasspath](/api/reference/org-pf4j-developmentpluginclasspath.html): It's a compound `PluginClasspath` (`MAVEN` + `GRADLE` + `KOTLIN`) used in development mode (`RuntimeMode#DEVELOPMENT`).
- [DevelopmentPluginLoader](/api/reference/org-pf4j-developmentpluginloader.html): Load all information needed by a plugin from `DevelopmentPluginClasspath`.
- [DevelopmentPluginRepository](/api/reference/org-pf4j-developmentpluginrepository.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [Extension](/api/reference/org-pf4j-extension.html): An extension is a class that extends an extension point.
- [ExtensionDescriptor](/api/reference/org-pf4j-extensiondescriptor.html): Describes an extension.
- [ExtensionFactory](/api/reference/org-pf4j-extensionfactory.html): Creates an extension instance.
- [ExtensionFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-extensionfinder.html): Provides the functionality for finding extensions.
- [ExtensionPoint](/api/reference/org-pf4j-extensionpoint.html): An extension point is a formal declaration in a plugin (or in application API) where customization is allowed.
- [ExtensionWrapper](/api/reference/org-pf4j-extensionwrapper.html): A wrapper over extension instance.
- [IndexedExtensionFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-indexedextensionfinder.html): All extensions declared in a plugin are indexed in a file META-INF/extensions.idx.
- [InvalidPluginDescriptorException](/api/reference/org-pf4j-invalidplugindescriptorexception.html): This exception signals incomplete or wrong information in the descriptor for a plugin.
- [JarPluginLoader](/api/reference/org-pf4j-jarpluginloader.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [JarPluginManager](/api/reference/org-pf4j-jarpluginmanager.html): It's a `PluginManager` that loads each plugin from a jar file.
- [JarPluginRepository](/api/reference/org-pf4j-jarpluginrepository.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [LegacyExtensionFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-legacyextensionfinder.html): All extensions declared in a plugin are indexed in a file META-INF/extensions.idx.
- [LoggingPluginStateListener](/api/reference/org-pf4j-loggingpluginstatelistener.html): It's an implementation of `PluginStateListener` that writes all events to logger (DEBUG level).
- [ManifestPluginDescriptorFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-manifestplugindescriptorfinder.html): Read the plugin descriptor from the manifest file.
- [Plugin](/api/reference/org-pf4j-plugin.html): This class will be extended by all plugins and serve as the common class between a plugin and the application.
- [PluginAlreadyLoadedException](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginalreadyloadedexception.html): Thrown when a plugin is already loaded.
- [PluginClassLoader](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginclassloader.html): One instance of this class should be created for every available plug-in.
- [PluginClasspath](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginclasspath.html): The classpath of the plugin.
- [PluginDependency](/api/reference/org-pf4j-plugindependency.html): A plugin dependency is a dependency that the plugin has on another plugin.
- [PluginDescriptor](/api/reference/org-pf4j-plugindescriptor.html): A plugin descriptor contains information about a plug-in.
- [PluginDescriptorFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-plugindescriptorfinder.html): Find a plugin descriptor for a plugin path.
- [PluginFactory](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginfactory.html): It's responsible for creating a plugin instance.
- [PluginLoader](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginloader.html): Load all information (classes) needed by a plugin.
- [PluginManager](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginmanager.html): Provides the functionality for plugin management such as load, start and stop the plugins.
- [PluginNotFoundException](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginnotfoundexception.html): Thrown when a plugin is not found.
- [PluginRepository](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginrepository.html): Directory that contains plugins.
- [PluginRuntimeException](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginruntimeexception.html): An exception used to indicate that a plugin problem occurred.
- [PluginStateEvent](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginstateevent.html): Event object that indicates a change in the state of a plugin.
- [PluginStateListener](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginstatelistener.html): Defines the interface for an object that listens to plugin state changes.
- [PluginStatusProvider](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginstatusprovider.html): Provides a way to check if a plugin is disabled and to disable/enable a plugin.
- [PluginWrapper](/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginwrapper.html): A wrapper over plugin instance.
- [PropertiesPluginDescriptorFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-propertiesplugindescriptorfinder.html): Find a plugin descriptor in a properties file (in plugin repository).
- [RuntimeMode](/api/reference/org-pf4j-runtimemode.html): The runtime mode of the PF4J application.
- [SecurePluginManagerWrapper](/api/reference/org-pf4j-securepluginmanagerwrapper.html): Use this class to wrap the original plugin manager to prevent full access from within plugins.
- [PluginStateListenerWrapper](/api/reference/org-pf4j-securepluginmanagerwrapper-pluginstatelistenerwrapper.html): Wrapper for PluginStateListener events.
- [ServiceProviderExtensionFinder](/api/reference/org-pf4j-serviceproviderextensionfinder.html): The `java.util.ServiceLoader` base implementation for `ExtensionFinder`.
- [SingletonExtensionFactory](/api/reference/org-pf4j-singletonextensionfactory.html): An `ExtensionFactory` that always returns a specific instance.
- [VersionManager](/api/reference/org-pf4j-versionmanager.html): Manager responsible for versions of plugins.
- [ZipPluginManager](/api/reference/org-pf4j-zippluginmanager.html): It's a `PluginManager` that loads each plugin from a zip file.
- [ExtensionInfo](/api/reference/org-pf4j-asm-extensioninfo.html): This class holds the parameters of an `org.pf4j.Extension` annotation defined for a certain class.
- [ExtensionVisitor](/api/reference/org-pf4j-asm-extensionvisitor.html): This visitor extracts an `ExtensionInfo` from any class, that holds an `Extension` annotation.
- [ExtensionAnnotationProcessor](/api/reference/org-pf4j-processor-extensionannotationprocessor.html): Processes `Extension` annotations and generates an `ExtensionStorage`.
- [ExtensionStorage](/api/reference/org-pf4j-processor-extensionstorage.html): It's a storage (database) that persists `org.pf4j.Extension`s.
- [IndexedExtensionStorage](/api/reference/org-pf4j-processor-indexedextensionstorage.html): Stores `org.pf4j.Extension`s in META-INF/extensions.idx.
- [LegacyExtensionStorage](/api/reference/org-pf4j-processor-legacyextensionstorage.html): Stores `org.pf4j.Extension`s in META-INF/extensions.idx.
- [ServiceProviderExtensionStorage](/api/reference/org-pf4j-processor-serviceproviderextensionstorage.html): Stores `org.pf4j.Extension`s in META-INF/services.
- [AndFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-andfilefilter.html): This filter providing conditional AND logic across a list of file filters.
- [ClassUtils](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-classutils.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [DirectedGraph](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-directedgraph.html): See Wikipedia for more information.
- [DirectoryFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-directoryfilefilter.html): Filter accepts files that are directories.
- [ExtensionFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-extensionfilefilter.html): Filter accepts any file ending in extension.
- [FileUtils](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-fileutils.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [HiddenFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-hiddenfilter.html): Filter that only accepts hidden files.
- [JarFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-jarfilefilter.html): File filter that accepts all files ending with .JAR.
- [NameFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-namefilefilter.html): Filter accepts any file with this name.
- [NotFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-notfilefilter.html): This filter produces a logical NOT of the filters specified.
- [OrFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-orfilefilter.html): This filter providing conditional OR logic across a list of file filters.
- [StringUtils](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-stringutils.html): **Author**: Decebal Suiu
- [Unzip](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-unzip.html): This class extracts the content of the plugin zip into a directory.
- [ZipFileFilter](/api/reference/org-pf4j-util-zipfilefilter.html): File filter that accepts all files ending with .ZIP.
- [lang](/api/reference/java-lang.html): lang
- [org](/api/reference/org.html): org
